info.name: Fuel Economy Web Services Emissions User MPG Menus API
Get makes with community MPG data

items.docs: Returns a list of vehicle makes for which community-contributed real-world MPG data exists. Spans historical makes including discontinued brands. Use the returned make values with the /ympg/shared/menu/model endpoint.

info.name: Get models with community MPG data for a make

params.name: make
params.description: Vehicle manufacturer name (e.g., Toyota, Ford). Must match a value from the make menu.

items.docs: Returns a list of vehicle models for the specified make for which community-contributed real-world MPG data exists. Use the returned values with the /ympg/shared/vehicles endpoint.

info.name: Get vehicles with community MPG data for a make and model

params.name: make
params.description: Vehicle manufacturer name (e.g., Toyota, Ford). Must match a value from the make menu.

params.name: model
params.description: Vehicle model name (e.g., Camry LE/SE). Must match a value from the model menu.

items.docs: Returns a list of vehicle records for the specified make and model that have community-contributed real-world MPG data. Each record contains full EPA fuel economy specifications and can be used to retrieve user MPG summaries via /ympg/shared/ympgVehicle/{id}.
